summary: An NSE index in Quote mode: the index frame carries LTP, OHLC, the previous close and the change worked out from them.

deviations.reason: mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:369, quote_data.get('oi', 0) over the parser's oi: 0 placeholder, mstockwebsocket.py:211), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out until a packet has carried one, and then sends the last OI the instrument's full packet carried on this connection (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs merges by presence), never a 0 it was not sent.
deviations.ref: decisions 2026-11-09: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out; web openalgo#2376

deviations.reason: mStock's index Quote packet carries the last quantity, average price and book totals (as 0, in the fixed 123-byte layout) and this web adapter sends them for an index as for any instrument (mstock_adapter.py:362-375); the desktop's renderer leaves an index's order-flow fields out for every broker (feed/protocol/market.rs shown_quote). Phase B: sent when the packet carries them, under the adapter's names, through the per-broker switch.
deviations.ref: lead rule 2026-11-09 (index: broker sent a value, desktop drops it -> open)

deviations.reason: The desktop sends price_change and price_change_percent in an index frame, worked out from the LTP and the previous close (100.75 and 0.42 here); mStock's web adapter sends no change for any instrument (mstock_adapter.py:340-433). Phase B drops them for mStock through the per-broker switch.
deviations.ref: lead rule 2026-11-09 (index price_change per adapter); audit C04
